status: Retrospective extension. All prior results known. New cross-sectional decisions recorded before new fits; not prospective preregistration.
primary_population: Country market exposure; not all legally covered issuers. Documented phase histories, not a verified global nonadoption census.
primary_inference: Country score/influence sampling diagnostics, fixed-calendar and fixed-match conditional; legal-wave uncertainty and endogenous adoption remain.
country_sample: At least 30 complete companies per country; fixed pre-policy largest-market-cap share line per vendor company; all three outcomes observed; documented not-yet-treated controls through endpoint.
new_regression_support: At least 2 adopting and 6 comparison countries, full rank, at least 3 residual df for interactions. Controls need 1 adopting and 3 comparison countries, full rank and at least 3 residual df.
moderator_timing: g-1 only. WGI contemporary revised vintage, not real-time information. No post-policy moderator or zero filling.
heterogeneity_unit: One unweighted eligible-country standard deviation, centred within cohort. Main treatment term is at cohort mean moderator; composition can differ across moderators.
matching: Distance uses pre-policy variables only on complete fixed-company samples. Covariance regularised by 1e-6 times trace/p; choose three nearest controls per adopting country with replacement. No outcome-driven caliper. Matching does not cure nonrandom regulation or guarantee balance.

tables.title: Main liquidity
tables.design: Existing reviewed following-year and years 1-3, three outcomes, GDP within families, both family weights.

tables.title: Country controls on identical samples
tables.design: Re-estimate cohort WLS with and without prior log GDP per capita, GDP growth and trade/GDP; freeze eligible rows before paired fits.

tables.title: Family-level liquidity
tables.design: All 13 supported following-year families, all three outcomes, no sign screening.

tables.title: Disclosure audience
tables.design: Public-disclosure, confidential-tax and other-family averages plus formal public-minus-confidential contrast using shared country covariance; interpret as cross-family heterogeneity.

tables.title: Prior liquidity
tables.design: Cohort WLS on treatment, centred pre-policy own-outcome, and interaction. Moderator scaled by unweighted country SD in each cohort.

tables.title: Regulatory quality
tables.design: Treatment interaction with pre-policy WGI regulatory quality; a broad institutional proxy, not policy-specific enforcement.

tables.title: Financial development
tables.design: Treatment interaction with pre-policy stock-market capitalisation/GDP; missing is not zero.

tables.title: Income and openness
tables.design: Separate interactions with prior log GDP per capita and trade/GDP.

tables.title: Matched-country comparisons
tables.design: Mahalanobis distances from pre-policy log GDP per capita, trade/GDP and all three liquidity levels. Three nearest documented comparison countries, with replacement. Report balance, attrition and conditional uncertainty.

tables.title: Event dynamics
tables.design: All balanced-sample event coefficients and joint pre-policy diagnostics, same seven-year company cohorts.

tables.title: Diffusion logit
tables.design: Preserve separate and joint JIBS-aligned status models, both weights and unstable fits.

tables.title: Diffusion with country-family effects
tables.design: Linear probability association models with country-family and year effects; separate and joint predictors, both weights; no claim of causality or substitute for failed logit chosen by sign.

selection: Retain all planned coefficients, unsupported cells and failed fits. No model or moderator chosen for sign or significance.
multiplicity: Holm over all newly attempted focal controlled, heterogeneity, matching and audience contrasts (unsupported cells padded with p=1); primary 12 and existing matrices remain separately labelled. LPM family has its own all-attempted correction.
censor: Exclude USA beneficial-ownership and DEU supply-chain observations if outcome window ends in or after 2025, consistently with prior history audit.
no_replication_claim: Country aggregates cannot reproduce reference firm financial controls or industry-year effects. Language is not the JIBS Berry cultural-distance measure.
journal_readiness: Table count and prose quality do not establish publishability. Assess identification, scope, legal timing, mechanism discrimination and independent reproducibility before calling submission-ready.

family_wave_sensitivity_addendum.reason: Country-family plus year effects may leave common family-specific adoption waves in language and learning associations. Add country-family plus family-year effects for every outcome, predictor set and weight, without selecting by result. Retain both designs and adjust across all 64 attempts.

user_scope_clarification.user_request: Interested in all disclosure regulations and whether in general there is a liquidity effect. User asked our recommendation on public versus confidential.
user_scope_clarification.recommended_primary: All ten identified public-disclosure families, subject to common data requirements.
user_scope_clarification.secondary: Combined public and confidential disclosure pool, confidential separately, and original 17-family sensitivity.
user_scope_clarification.reason: Public information is the direct investor-information mechanism. Confidential reports are a different audience and are not a placebo. Auditor institutions/rotation, broad governance codes, beneficial-owner registers and digital authorisation categories are not consistently new listed-company reporting requirements. Scope is not chosen by estimated sign.

numerical_support_clarification.rule: Withhold FE models with effectively zero residualised outcome variance, rank deficiency at numerical tolerance, nonfinite or zero clustered standard errors. Calculate absorbed df from actual FE graph connected components.
numerical_support_clarification.reason: An absorbed outcome or zero numerical variance is not an estimated null effect; all failed cells remain listed.

table_presentation.note: The reference-style public-sample logit table is a support diagnostic because none of the attempted models is stable; it is not counted as one of the twelve tables containing estimated regression coefficients.
